A regular expression is a formula for matching strings that follow some pattern. The formula (and syntax used) varies depending on the method of searching used. Lua, the scripting language that World of Warcraft uses, does not support regular expressions. Instead, it offers a basic pattern-matching mechanism with most of the features of REs. Though since Lua doesn't implement regexes, at all, but rather "patterns", this can confuse more than it helps. Better refer to the official Lua documentation (which never mentions "regular expressions").

A pearl is a precious gem-like item that is usually found inside clams. Pearls are commonly used as ingredients in different professions, such as Blacksmithing, Jewelcrafting, or Tailoring. They may also be used as quest-related items, or simply vendor trash. The Iridescent Pearl (quest item) may be the most perfect of all pearls.

Paval Reethe was a deserter from the Theramore Guard. Raval Reethe joined the Theramore Guard along with most of the recruits that came across the sea with Lady Proudmoore. He enlisted with the marines of Kul Tiras at the age of sixteen. Reethe had distinguished service and was promoted to lieutenant, but currently is listed as missing in official records. In fact he deserted the Theramore Guard and joined deserters at Lost Point. There he insisted on raiding the supplies of the ogres up at Brackenwall Village, though deserters were not so many in number to stand up to the ogres. Pavonum was a Blizzard employee who worked in the [https://web.archive.org/web/20071229001346/http://forums.worldofwarcraft.com/board.html?sid=1&forumId=11112 Customer Service Forum] until December 28, 2007. His avatar was an owlbeast native to the Hinterlands. Pavonum was known for being verbose, using signatures from foreign languages (often Latin or French), and enjoying tea. His penchant for disassembling ill-considered arguments, as well as decimating attempts at deception with piercing facts and vicious rhetoric, inspired the term "Pavowned" for any occasion where would-be pretenders were swept away in a deluge of words, statistics, and collective disdain from regulars. Pearlfin Village is a town controlled by the Pearlfin Jinyu, jinyu friendly to the Alliance, located at the shores of Pearl Lake in the Jade Forest. After the Horde allied with the hozen and captured Anduin Wrynn, a small team infiltrated the village, killing many guards and planting poisonous barrels there.
Pearl Lake is a subzone of Jade Forest. It surrounds Pearlfin Village and borders the Slingtail Pits.

Paw'don Village is a pandaren village just north of Garrosh'ar Point, led by Mayor Sunke Khang. The village is divided into two parts, connected by a bridge. Unlike the usual brews produced by the pandaren, Paw'don Village is known for their apple cider, which is prized throughout the Jade Forest. They are thus dependent on their apple orchard; it not only provides the villagers' food supply, but the village's livelihood as well. A direct portal to Paw'don Village, maintained by Tushui Magisters, exists in the Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind.
The Pearlfin Jinyu (or Pearlfin tribe) allied with the Alliance to stand a chance of fending off a Forest Hozen assault. They are long time enemies of the forest hozen.
